name: Hiriya Seita
source:
A student who originally intends to enter the Athletics Department. But due to an accident, he was forced to be transfered to the Department of Cultural Studies instead, where most of the student and faculty are made of girls only.

He then finds himself in a situation where girls blame girls due to everyone violating school regulations, causing chaos. He takes advantage of the situation by using the school's network to uncover the girls' weakness and make them do whatever he wants them to do...
